row.evidence: Transcend's access-control docs describe only manual adds, SAML just-in-time provisioning with group-to-team mapping, and GraphQL removeUser/disableUserAccount mutations; no SCIM endpoint is documented.
row.notes: Quote-only: transcend.io/pricing redirects to a Contact us / demo form. No SCIM: users are created by SAML JIT on first sign-in (SSO groups or title/department map to Transcend teams; later logins only add teams, never remove), removed by an admin or the GraphQL API, or blocked by deactivating them in the IdP. SSO is SAML with a custom app per IdP (Okta, Entra, Google, OneLogin, Auth0); a plans announcement on Transcend's blog says the Core Platform on every plan includes unlimited seats and single sign-on. Scored as none; JIT-only may be reclassified at merge.

user_api.notes: GraphQL playground at the API host lists all operations; only the user mutations shown in the access-control article were verified. Base URL is api.us.transcend.io for US hosting.

entra.notes: Custom (non-gallery) enterprise application; no Entra gallery entry in the SaaS-apps TOC.
